messages.subject: R and general statistics tutor wanted for dissertation analyses (paid)
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I am a PhD student in ecology, and while I make a mean sheep herder and counter of plants, statistics and programming has been a weak link for me. I have a couple of projects in need of analysis, and while I have been muddling through them for several months now, I definitely feel the need for some serious assistance, both in terms of the statistics (am I using the most appropriate tests, meeting the assumptions, visualizing the data) and R coding. 

I am searching for PAID help! Potential for co-authorship if you are interested in really getting into it??
Either a semi-regular, weekly (or so) meeting, or larger chunks of time more infrequently is fine with me - whatever works for the willing mentor. 

Some of the issues I am tackling: 
plain 'ol ANOVA and contrasts
repeated measures mixed effects MANOVA
generating appropriate graphics
meta-analysis, mixed effects ANOVA
and why, oh why, won't my simple For-Loops work?

I can be reached at 530-750-9771, or by email: kmwolf at ucdavis dot edu

Thank you, 
Signed - desperately seeker stats-help! 
aka, Kristina
